note: Fits commercially and on capability, misses on profile and starting point. Income holds: he agreed to $6,000 at full price with no value resistance — 'I don't have a problem with 6,000' — and the only constraint was moving funds between accounts. Health is genuinely the neglected corner of an otherwise functional life rather than a crisis: he is medicated for cholesterol and sleeping badly, but he serves, works and passes his fitness tests. Not deconditioned holds despite 31-32% body fat — he is a serving soldier who meets Army physical fitness requirements with no limitations and was a two-time national-title figure skater, which is the opposite of the gym-averse exclusion the ICP names. Where he falls outside is occupation and starting point: he is a salaried Army HR administrator, not a business owner or physician, and at 211 lb with over 60 lb of fat and a 230 lb peak he is asking for reversal, not for good to great — 'my body indicators are telling me that I'm in a negative trajectory.' The finding worth escalating is that the marketing screens him out on a criterion the ICP does not even contain: Trevor's videos ask for men aged 30-45 and he is 52, which he raised three times on the call and which nearly stopped him booking at all.
